We Are Istra

The heart of our company is a dynamic team of highly skilled individuals with backgrounds in mathematics, computer science, statistics, physics, engineering, and finance.  As a growing company, Istra is committed to recruiting and retaining top-notch technologists and scientists who are passionate truth seekers and problem solvers and want to work on some of the most challenging Big Data problems.

Life @ Istra

What Makes Us Unique?

Excellence

At Istra, we strive for excellence in everything we do. We believe that pursuing the highest standards of performance is essential to achieving success. We encourage our team members to set ambitious goals and continuously improve their skills and knowledge.

Innovation

At Istra we believe that staying ahead of the curve is key to our success in a rapidly evolving competitive industry. We encourage creativity and experimentation to develop new trading strategies and technologies. We value team members who are willing to take risks, challenge the status quo, and push boundaries.

Intellectual Curiosity​

We value a thirst for knowledge and a desire to understand the underlying principles of our work. We encourage our team members to ask questions and pursue answers to complex problems. As a company we encourage curiosity and a willingness to embrace new challenges by staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies.

Collaboration

At Istra we recognize that the success of our company depends on the collective contributions of our team. We value collaboration and open communication to foster a strong, cohesive culture.

Speed and Efficiency

At Istra we value the ability to move quickly and make fast decisions. We prioritize efficiency in everything we do, from optimizing our algorithms to streamlining our processes. From day one, you’ll have the chance to make an impact in a business where ideas matter more than position or seniority.

What To Expect During Recruitment

At Istra, our recruiting process is more than just a series of interviews. We believe in a dynamic approach that challenges your intellect and aligns with our culture. The recruiting process includes mind-bending riddles, intriguing math problems, and stimulating algorithm questions tailored to the role you’re pursuing. During this process you will get a sense of the Istra spirit by meeting our people, learning about life at Istra and determining if we share the same culture and mindset.  

Our Recruiting Team is dedicated to guiding you through the process, ensuring you are well-informed and updated at every stage.
